key_insight: Gradient-trained parameterized quantum circuits can show double descent, meaning larger/deeper models may generalize better instead of worse.
engineering_relevance: For quantum ML system design, increasing circuit size is not automatically risky for generalization, so model scaling can be explored more confidently.
method: Derived analytical generalization behavior using add-one-in perturbation techniques.
Used spectral properties of random matrices to justify the scaling trend.
Validated the theory with re-uploading PQC experiments across multiple datasets and training set sizes.
evidence_signal: Numerical experiments consistently observed double descent across several datasets and training sizes, matching the analytical prediction.
watch_item: The result is encouraging but does not remove other practical obstacles in quantum machine learning, such as trainability, noise, and hardware constraints.
paper_title: Cautious optimism for deep parameterized quantum circuits
